values.note: April-October all sites; November-March three full-hookup sites, self-contained rigs only, restrooms winterized.
Online, or phone 765-564-2870. Self check-in at the Gray Barn; check-in 1 pm, check-out noon. A further seven days only after one month away. No generators.

note: Run by the non-profit Carroll County Wabash & Erie Canal Inc., Delphi, behind the Interpretive Center. Big rigs: the Washington St. approach has a steep railroad crossing; the operator's truck route turns north on 9th St. from SR 39/US 421. --Claude
